packs.name: Advanced editing
packs.description: Restructure, simplify, reformat and make longer drafts consistent.

actions.name: Restructure a difficult draft
actions.instruction: Restructure the selected draft into a clear, logical order. Preserve all relevant content, improve transitions, and use headings or lists only where they genuinely help the reader.

actions.name: Simplify complex writing
actions.instruction: Rewrite the selected text so a general reader can understand it more easily. Preserve the facts, necessary technical terms, qualifications, and intended meaning, and explain unavoidable jargon briefly.

actions.name: Choose a clearer format
actions.instruction: Reformat the selected text using paragraphs, headings, or bullet points according to what makes the content easiest to follow. Preserve the information and do not add new claims.

actions.name: Improve consistency
actions.instruction: Revise the selected text for consistent terminology, tense, point of view, tone, capitalisation, and formatting. Preserve intentional differences and do not silently resolve factual contradictions.

packs.name: Customer relations
packs.description: Reply to selected customer queries, request missing details, explain limits and confirm resolutions.

actions.name: Reply to the selected customer query
actions.instruction: Treat the selected text as a query from a customer and draft a helpful, professional reply. Answer the points supported by the supplied information, make any next step clear, and do not invent policy, stock, timings, compensation, or commitments.

actions.name: Ask the customer for missing information
actions.instruction: Treat the selected text as a customer query that cannot yet be resolved. Draft a concise reply acknowledging the request and asking only for the missing information genuinely needed to help. Explain why a detail is needed when that is not obvious, and do not repeat questions already answered.

actions.name: Explain a limitation or declined request
actions.instruction: Use the selected customer message and supplied context to draft a clear, respectful reply explaining why a request cannot be fulfilled or must be limited. Acknowledge the practical impact, state the decision without evasive wording, and offer alternatives only when they are supported by the supplied information.

actions.name: Confirm the resolution and next steps
actions.instruction: Turn the selected customer correspondence or case notes into a concise follow-up reply. Confirm what has been resolved, clearly identify any remaining action and who should take it, and preserve supplied dates or reference details without inventing commitments.

packs.name: Email and correspondence
packs.description: Turn notes into emails, follow up, make wording diplomatic and write clear requests.

actions.name: Draft an email from notes
actions.instruction: Turn the selected notes into a complete email. Make the purpose and any requested next step clear, use a natural professional tone, and do not invent names, dates, promises, or attachments.

actions.name: Send a polite follow-up
actions.instruction: Draft a polite follow-up email based on the selected text. Briefly establish the context, make the requested next step clear, and avoid sounding impatient or passive-aggressive.

actions.name: Make an email more diplomatic
actions.instruction: Rewrite the selected email to be tactful and constructive while keeping the issue, boundaries, and requested action clear. Do not make it vague, overly apologetic, or insincere.

actions.name: Turn selected notes into a request email
actions.instruction: Turn the selected notes into a concise request email. Explain the context needed by the recipient, state the requested action clearly, and include a deadline or preferred response only when one is supplied. Do not invent names, dates, commitments, or attachments.

packs.name: Tone and voice
packs.description: Make writing softer, more direct, warmer or more formal without changing its meaning.

actions.name: Make softer and more diplomatic
actions.instruction: Rewrite the selected text so it is calmer, more diplomatic, and easier to receive while keeping the substantive point, boundaries, and requested action clear. Do not make it vague or insincere.

actions.name: Make more direct
actions.instruction: Rewrite the selected text to be more direct and decisive. Preserve its meaning and necessary context, remove hedging and filler, and keep it civil rather than abrasive.

actions.name: Make warmer and friendlier
actions.instruction: Rewrite the selected text in a warm, friendly, and approachable voice. Preserve the facts and purpose, and avoid fake enthusiasm, excessive familiarity, or generic pleasantries.

actions.name: Make formal and professional
actions.instruction: Rewrite the selected text in a clear, professional, and appropriately formal register. Preserve its meaning and individual voice, and avoid stiff phrasing, jargon, or invented details.

packs.name: Complaints and resolution
packs.description: Raise, answer, summarise and escalate complaints constructively.

actions.name: Turn selected notes into a clear complaint
actions.instruction: Turn the selected facts and notes into a firm, constructive complaint. Explain what happened, the practical impact, and the desired resolution clearly. Do not invent evidence, dates, policies, or legal claims.

actions.name: Reply to the selected complaint
actions.instruction: Treat the selected text as a complaint I received and draft a calm professional response. Acknowledge the concern without automatically admitting fault, address the key issue, and propose a reasonable next step without inventing policy, compensation, or commitments.

actions.name: Summarise the selected complaint history
actions.instruction: Summarise the selected complaint correspondence into a neutral case note. Separate the issue, relevant timeline, evidence or claims, actions already taken, unresolved points, and requested outcome. Clearly distinguish facts from allegations or uncertainty.

actions.name: Turn selected complaint history into an escalation
actions.instruction: Draft a concise escalation based on the selected complaint history. State what remains unresolved, refer accurately to prior contact, explain the desired remedy or next step, and remain firm and professional without making unsupported threats.

packs.name: Reports and updates
packs.description: Convert notes and evidence into structured reports, summaries and updates.

actions.name: Turn notes into a report
actions.instruction: Turn the selected notes into a clear structured report. Organise the material into purpose, relevant context, findings, and next steps or recommendations where supported. Preserve uncertainties and do not invent evidence.

actions.name: Summarise the selected report for executives
actions.instruction: Create a concise executive summary of the selected report. Prioritise the purpose, most important findings, material risks or limitations, decisions required, and recommended next steps. Do not add claims that are not supported by the source.

actions.name: Turn selected project notes into a status update
actions.instruction: Turn the selected project notes into a concise status update. Separate completed work, current work, blockers or risks, decisions needed, and next steps. Preserve owners and dates exactly when provided and do not invent progress.

actions.name: Extract findings and actions from selected text
actions.instruction: Extract the key findings, supporting evidence, risks or limitations, and concrete actions from the selected text. Keep each action tied to the finding that justifies it and retain named owners or deadlines only when supplied.

packs.name: Social media writing
packs.description: Turn selected notes, arguments and updates into posts, threads, captions and announcements.

actions.name: Turn notes into a social post
actions.instruction: Turn the selected notes into a concise social post for a general online audience. Lead with the main point, keep the voice natural, and avoid manufactured enthusiasm, engagement bait, excessive hashtags, or invented personal details.

actions.name: Turn an argument into a short thread
actions.instruction: Turn the selected argument into a short, coherent social-media thread. Give each post one clear purpose, preserve the reasoning and important qualifications, and avoid clickbait, fake quotations, or unsupported certainty.

actions.name: Turn selected text into a concise caption
actions.instruction: Turn the selected text into a concise social-media caption. Preserve the central point and relevant concrete detail, make it understandable alongside an image or video, and avoid clickbait, excessive hashtags, or invented personal experience.

actions.name: Turn the selected update into an announcement post
actions.instruction: Turn the selected update into a clear social-media announcement. Lead with what is new, retain the details readers need and any supplied date or action, and keep the post easy to scan without inventing reasons, commitments, or promotional claims.

packs.name: Social media replies
packs.description: Reply to selected YouTube, Reddit and Facebook text using platform-appropriate style and length.

actions.name: Reply to the selected YouTube comment
actions.instruction: Treat the selected text as a YouTube comment and draft a concise public reply. Address its main point directly in a conversational tone that works below a video. Keep it to one short paragraph unless clarification genuinely requires more, and avoid hashtags, creator-style hype, insults, or invented facts.

actions.name: Reply to the selected Reddit post or comment
actions.instruction: Treat the selected text as a Reddit post or comment and draft a useful reply. Be direct and substantive, include enough reasoning to stand on its own in a threaded discussion, and use short paragraphs where helpful. Avoid corporate language, unnecessary hashtags, fake quotations, and claims not supported by the source.

actions.name: Reply to the selected Facebook post or comment
actions.instruction: Treat the selected text as a Facebook post or comment and draft a friendly, accessible public reply. Address the important point in a moderately brief conversational style, preserve necessary context for mixed audiences, and avoid jargon, excessive hashtags, or invented familiarity.

actions.name: De-escalate the selected hostile exchange
actions.instruction: Treat the selected text as part of a hostile public social-media exchange and draft a calm, concise reply. Correct the central point or restate the boundary without mirroring insults, escalating the tone, inviting a pile-on, or claiming facts not supplied. Make disengagement clear when further argument would not be productive.

packs.name: Social media editing
packs.description: Edit selected text for YouTube, Reddit and Facebook conventions or create versions for all three.

actions.name: Edit the selected text for YouTube
actions.instruction: Edit the selected text for use on YouTube, inferring whether it is a comment, community post, or video description from its content. Use a clear opening and compact, conversational wording; keep comments especially brief. Preserve facts and individual voice, and avoid clickbait, filler, and unnecessary hashtags.

actions.name: Edit the selected text for Reddit
actions.instruction: Edit the selected text for a Reddit post or comment. Make the point clear early, retain useful context and reasoning, and use short paragraphs or restrained Markdown when it improves scanning. Keep the voice natural and non-promotional, and do not add hashtags, fake quotations, or unsupported certainty.

actions.name: Edit the selected text for Facebook
actions.instruction: Edit the selected text for Facebook. Use warm, accessible language and a clear first sentence, keep the length moderate, and split longer material into readable short paragraphs. Preserve the writer's meaning and facts, and avoid engagement bait, excessive hashtags, or generic promotional wording.

actions.name: Adapt selected text for YouTube, Reddit and Facebook
actions.instruction: Create three clearly labelled versions of the selected text: YouTube, Reddit, and Facebook. Preserve the central meaning and facts while adapting length, structure, tone, and platform conventions: concise and conversational for YouTube, substantive and discussion-friendly for Reddit, and warm and accessible for Facebook. Do not invent details or add engagement bait.

packs.name: Reviews and feedback
packs.description: Write balanced reviews, compare products and give useful feedback.

actions.name: Polish a product review
actions.instruction: Edit the selected product review so it is clear, honest, useful, and balanced. Preserve the writer's actual experience and concrete product details, improve readability, and avoid exaggeration or marketing language.

actions.name: Write a product review from notes
actions.instruction: Turn the selected notes into a complete product review. Explain the relevant experience, useful strengths and weaknesses, and overall assessment without inventing features, results, dates, or usage details.

actions.name: Turn observations into constructive feedback
actions.instruction: Turn the selected observations into clear, constructive feedback. Separate what worked, what could improve, and practical suggestions, while remaining specific, fair, and respectful.

actions.name: Turn selected notes into a comparison review
actions.instruction: Turn the selected notes into a balanced comparison of the products or options mentioned. Compare them on the supplied criteria, explain the trade-offs, and state which type of user each suits without inventing specifications or test results.

packs.name: Meetings and actions
packs.description: Prepare agendas, turn notes into minutes, extract actions and draft follow-ups.

actions.name: Turn selected notes into a meeting agenda
actions.instruction: Turn the selected notes into a practical meeting agenda. State the purpose, organise the discussion topics logically, identify decisions needed, and retain times or owners only when supplied.

actions.name: Turn notes into meeting minutes
actions.instruction: Turn the selected meeting notes into concise minutes. Separate attendees when supplied, discussion points, decisions, unresolved questions, and next steps. Preserve uncertainty and do not invent agreement or attendance.

actions.name: Extract decisions and action items
actions.instruction: Extract decisions and action items from the selected meeting text. For each action, retain its owner and deadline only when explicitly supplied, and list unresolved questions separately.

actions.name: Turn selected meeting notes into a follow-up
actions.instruction: Draft a concise follow-up message from the selected meeting notes. Summarise the agreed outcome, list next steps, and make any requested response clear without inventing agreement, owners, or deadlines.

packs.name: Technical communication
packs.description: Explain issues, write bug reports and support requests, and plan safe troubleshooting.

actions.name: Turn notes into a bug report
actions.instruction: Turn the selected notes into a reproducible bug report. Separate the environment, steps, expected behaviour, actual behaviour, frequency, and relevant evidence. Mark missing information clearly and do not invent technical details.

actions.name: Turn selected notes into a support request
actions.instruction: Turn the selected notes into a concise support request. Explain the problem, impact, relevant setup, troubleshooting already attempted, and the help required without inventing error messages, versions, or results.

actions.name: Explain technical text simply
actions.instruction: Explain the selected technical text for a non-specialist reader. Preserve its important meaning, define necessary terminology in plain language, and distinguish established facts from assumptions or uncertainty.

actions.name: Turn the selected problem into a troubleshooting plan
actions.instruction: Create a practical troubleshooting plan for the selected problem. Start with the quickest and lowest-risk checks, explain what each check would establish, and avoid destructive steps or unsupported certainty.

packs.name: Study and learning
packs.description: Turn source text into explanations, notes, flashcards and self-test questions.

actions.name: Turn selected text into structured study notes
actions.instruction: Turn the selected text into concise structured study notes. Preserve key concepts, definitions, relationships, examples, and important qualifications without adding unsupported facts.

actions.name: Explain a difficult concept
actions.instruction: Explain the main concept in the selected text in clear stages for a learner who is new to the topic. Use a simple example where the source supports one, and identify any important prerequisite knowledge.

actions.name: Create flashcards from selected text
actions.instruction: Create a compact set of question-and-answer flashcards from the selected text. Cover the most important concepts and distinctions, keep each answer focused, and do not introduce material absent from the source.

actions.name: Create a self-test quiz from selected text
actions.instruction: Create a short self-test quiz from the selected text using a useful mix of recall and application questions. Put the answer key after the questions and base every answer on the source.

packs.name: CVs and applications
packs.description: Improve CV evidence, draft cover letters, tailor profiles and shape interview answers.

actions.name: Turn notes into CV bullet points
actions.instruction: Turn the selected work notes into concise CV bullet points. Emphasise responsibilities, actions, and demonstrated outcomes, but do not invent metrics, achievements, job titles, tools, or dates.

actions.name: Draft a cover letter from notes
actions.instruction: Turn the selected notes into a focused cover letter. Connect the supplied experience to the role requirements, keep the voice natural and specific, and do not invent qualifications, employers, achievements, or enthusiasm.

actions.name: Improve a professional profile
actions.instruction: Rewrite the selected professional profile so it is concise, credible, and specific about the person's supplied experience and strengths. Avoid generic claims, buzzwords, and invented accomplishments.

actions.name: Shape an interview answer
actions.instruction: Turn the selected notes into a clear interview answer with useful context, the person's actions, and the result. Preserve the supplied facts and voice, and do not invent achievements, figures, or lessons learned.

packs.name: Replies to selected text
packs.description: Write sarcastic, challenging, firm or balanced replies to selected text.

actions.name: Sarcastic reply
actions.instruction: Treat the selected text as a message, post, or comment and write a concise sarcastic reply. Make it witty and pointed, target the claim or conduct rather than protected traits or irrelevant personal characteristics, and avoid threats, slurs, or invented facts.

actions.name: Challenge the selected text
actions.instruction: Treat the selected text as a claim or argument and write a reasoned reply that challenges it. Identify its weakest assumption, misleading framing, or missing context, explain the disagreement clearly, and do not invent evidence or certainty.

actions.name: Write a polite but firm reply
actions.instruction: Treat the selected text as something another person wrote and draft a polite but firm reply. Address the important points directly, make my position or boundary clear, and avoid unnecessary hostility, vague wording, or invented facts and commitments.

actions.name: Acknowledge the strongest point and reply
actions.instruction: Draft a reply to the selected text that addresses its strongest reasonable interpretation rather than an easy caricature. Briefly acknowledge valid points or uncertainty, then explain the disagreement clearly using only facts supplied in the source or additional context.

packs.name: Arguments and evidence
packs.description: Strengthen, check, challenge and balance arguments without turning them into replies.

actions.name: Strengthen my argument
actions.instruction: Strengthen the selected argument by making its reasoning clearer, addressing the most likely objection, and improving its structure. Preserve the writer's position and voice, distinguish assumptions from facts, and do not invent evidence, quotations, or statistics.

actions.name: Fact-check and draft a correction
actions.instruction: Fact-check the important claims in the selected text and draft a concise correction. Separate what is supported, misleading, uncertain, or false. Use web search when current or reliable verification is needed, cite the most relevant sources, and do not overstate what the evidence establishes.

actions.name: Find weak points in an argument
actions.instruction: Analyse the selected argument and identify its weakest reasoning, unsupported assumptions, missing evidence, and strongest plausible counterarguments. Distinguish fixable presentation problems from substantive gaps, and do not invent facts or sources.

actions.name: Rewrite as a balanced argument
actions.instruction: Rewrite the selected text as a clear, balanced argument. Preserve its central position, represent meaningful counterarguments fairly, retain important qualifications and uncertainty, and avoid claiming more than the supplied evidence supports.

packs.name: Summaries and extraction
packs.description: Turn selected source text into summaries, extracted facts, open questions and timelines.

actions.name: Summarise the selected text
actions.instruction: Summarise the selected text concisely for a reader who has not seen the original. Preserve its main conclusion, important facts, qualifications, and disagreements, and do not add interpretation that the source does not support.

actions.name: Extract facts and figures
actions.instruction: Extract the concrete facts, figures, dates, named parties, and stated outcomes from the selected text. Keep their surrounding qualifications and attribution, distinguish reported claims from established facts, and do not infer missing values.

actions.name: List answered and open questions
actions.instruction: Identify the important questions addressed by the selected text. Separate those it answers from those it leaves partly answered or unresolved, give each supported answer concisely, and do not fill gaps with assumptions.

actions.name: Create a factual timeline
actions.instruction: Turn the selected text into a factual chronological timeline. Retain dates and event descriptions exactly where supplied, mark ambiguous or conflicting chronology, and do not invent dates, causes, or an order the source does not establish.

packs.name: Draft from selected text
packs.description: Develop rough notes or source material into a complete draft, FAQ, instructions or announcement.

actions.name: Turn rough notes into a complete draft
actions.instruction: Turn the selected rough notes into a coherent, ready-to-use draft. Preserve every supplied fact and constraint, infer a sensible structure and purpose from the notes, and do not invent names, evidence, dates, commitments, or personal experience.

actions.name: Turn the text into an FAQ
actions.instruction: Turn the selected source text into a concise reader-facing FAQ. Use the questions a reader is most likely to ask, answer each only from the supplied material, preserve uncertainty or limitations, and do not invent policy or facts.

actions.name: Turn the text into instructions
actions.instruction: Turn the selected material into clear step-by-step instructions. Put prerequisites and warnings before the relevant steps, keep terminology consistent, identify gaps rather than guessing, and do not introduce unsafe or unsupported procedures.

actions.name: Write an announcement from notes
actions.instruction: Turn the selected notes into a clear announcement. Lead with what is changing or happening, explain who is affected and any required action, retain supplied dates and contact details exactly, and do not invent decisions, reasons, or commitments.

packs.name: Decisions and planning
packs.description: Compare selected options, prioritise items, build an action plan and surface risks.

actions.name: Compare the selected options
actions.instruction: Compare the options described in the selected text using the criteria and constraints supplied. Explain the practical trade-offs, identify missing information, and recommend an option only when the source supports doing so; state any assumptions behind the recommendation.

actions.name: Prioritise the selected items
actions.instruction: Prioritise the items in the selected text using any stated urgency, impact, effort, dependencies, and constraints. Explain the ordering briefly, preserve ties or uncertainty, and do not invent priorities or deadlines when the criteria are missing.

actions.name: Turn the goal into an action plan
actions.instruction: Turn the goal, constraints, or notes in the selected text into a practical action plan. Order the steps, identify dependencies and decision points, retain supplied owners or dates, and mark missing information instead of inventing commitments.

actions.name: Identify risks and open questions
actions.instruction: Review the selected plan, proposal, or decision and list its material risks, assumptions, dependencies, and unanswered questions. Tie each point to the source, distinguish likelihood from impact where possible, and do not present speculation as fact.
